fields.description: The domain mail is sent from and received for, e.g. acme.com. Lowercased and IDNA-encoded on save; it names the record and cannot change.
fields.label: Domain Name

fields.description: The site that owns this domain. Empty for a domain Central manages.
fields.label: Site

fields.description: The site's cluster, copied on every save. The domain is created on this cluster and its DNS records point at it.
fields.label: Cluster

fields.description: Unchecked, the domain stops sending and receiving on the cluster and loses its verification, so it must be verified again after it is enabled. Its accounts and aliases stay in place.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Free text shown on the cluster next to the domain. Blank falls back to the site's name.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: The domain's id on the cluster, set when it is created there. Blank means the cluster never accepted it.
fields.label: Stalwart ID

fields.description: Receives mail addressed to local parts that match no account or alias. Blank rejects such mail.
fields.label: Catch-all Address

fields.description: user+tag@domain delivers to user@domain. Turn off if a local part legitimately contains a plus sign.
fields.label: Sub-addressing

fields.description: Relay mail for addresses of this domain that have no account here to the domain's MX (split delivery, for domains that keep some mailboxes on another server). Off rejects such mail, or delivers it to the catch-all address.
fields.label: Allow Relaying

fields.description: Off when another region holds this domain's mailboxes: accounts here only send, and mail for the domain is relayed to its MX.
fields.label: Holds Mailboxes

fields.description: Also list the MTA-STS, autoconfig and autodiscover records. Those hostnames are served over HTTPS and get no certificate from the cluster, so leave this off unless the site handles TLS for them.
fields.label: Publish Client Discovery Records

fields.description: Set by Verify DNS Records when SPF, DMARC and at least one DKIM record resolve to the expected values on public resolvers. Mail flows only while this is checked and the domain is enabled. A System Manager or Suite Cloud Manager can set it by hand; the hourly check re-verifies domains that are unchecked, and checked ones with a mandatory record still unresolved, which unchecks a domain verified by hand unless Skip Scheduled Verification is on.
fields.label: Verified

fields.description: Checked, the hourly check leaves this domain alone, so Verified stays as it was last set, by hand or by the action. Verify DNS Records still resolves the records on demand.
fields.label: Skip Scheduled Verification

fields.description: Verified on the cloud's word while Skip Domain Verification (Mail Settings) was on, with the hourly check left out. Turning that setting off clears this and checks the records like any other domain's.
fields.label: Verification Skipped

fields.description: When the records were last resolved, by the Verify DNS Records action or the hourly check of unverified domains.
fields.label: Last Verified At

fields.description: Daily checks in a row that found the ownership record gone.
fields.label: Ownership Misses

fields.description: When the record rows were last rebuilt from the cluster's zone file, by the Refresh DNS Records action or the hourly check for keys the cluster was still generating.
fields.label: Records Refreshed At

fields.description: Mandatory. Records that stop others sending mail as this domain: SPF, DKIM and DMARC. Mail flows once SPF, DMARC and at least one DKIM selector resolve.
fields.label: Email Authentication

fields.description: Optional. Points mail sent to this domain at the cluster. Leave it out to keep receiving elsewhere and use the cluster for sending only.
fields.label: Inbound Mail Routing

fields.description: Optional. Asks sending servers to insist on encrypted delivery (MTA-STS) and to report failed or insecure connections (TLS-RPT). MTA-STS rows appear only with Publish Client Discovery Records on.
fields.label: Transport Security

fields.description: Optional. Lets mail, calendar and contacts apps find the servers for this domain on their own.
fields.label: Service Discovery

fields.description: Optional. Lets mail clients set themselves up from just an address. These hostnames are served over HTTPS by the cluster, which holds no certificate for them.
fields.label: Client Auto-configuration

fields.description: The zone file the cluster generated for the domain, as last refreshed. The tables above are parsed from it.
fields.label: Zone File

fields.description: Outbound mail of this domain leaves through this pool instead of the site's or the cluster's default. The pool must belong to the domain's cluster.
fields.label: Egress Pool
